# Heart Rate sub-actions

## Get heart rate

Looks up your latest heart rate and saves it in variables. Handy for a "!heart" chat command.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Source** | Where to read it from. Latest uses whichever app reported most recently. Or choose Pulsoid or HypeRate. Options: Latest, Pulsoid, HypeRate. Starts as: `Latest`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%heartRateAvailable%` | True if a reading was found |
| `%heartRate%` | Beats per minute (0 if none) |
| `%heartRateSource%` | Where it came from |
| `%heartRateTime%` | When it was measured |
| `%heartRateAgeSeconds%` | How many seconds old it is (-1 if none) |

<small>Type id: `heartrate.get`</small>
